startingFixture.knowledge: First-player visible onboarding, map, HUD, command guide, and player-facing shortcuts only; no implementation facts, hidden coordinates, author hints, or candidate coaching.
startingFixture.sourceIdentity: Accepted building source pixels, logical IDs, authored directions, frontage, pivot, scale, tint, and registration remain unchanged.

frame.camera: Enter Focus City, frame Developed City, then canonical neighborhood zoom

cameraAndFrames.measurements: unmeasured until an exact Integration-authorized candidate is operated

visualContract.courtRole: road-facing terraced frontage court derived from the normalized authoritative frontage socket; visibly separate from and connected to the entrance
visualContract.groveRole: multi-lobed northwest-lit garden-grove crown with grounded trunks, companion canopy, hedge/planting bed, and contact shadow
visualContract.byteRepeat: two fresh color and integer Rec.709 grayscale exports must be byte-identical
visualContract.recognition: grove and court must read without labels or zoom crops; the pair must remain non-aliased at every governed LOD
visualContract.grounding: underlay is naturally occluded by the accepted sprite; foreground accent contains only depth-near vertical details and no broad filled polygon
visualContract.envelope: all context stays inside the 72x36 lot diamond, outside the 16x8 road envelope, with unobstructed entrance-to-road path

automaticRejects.courtVisiblePixelFloor: reject if any regular frame has fewer than 200 composed court pixels or compact has fewer than 90
automaticRejects.courtSurvival: reject if isolated-to-composed court survival is below 55%
automaticRejects.foregroundSpriteOverlap: reject any opaque foreground-court overlap with an accepted building sprite
automaticRejects.contrast: reject below 18 color-derived or below 12 grayscale Rec.709 luma separation
automaticRejects.repeatIdentity: reject any non-byte-identical two-run color/grayscale sheet
automaticRejects.pairRecognition: reject if the starter grove/court pair is not decision-usefully distinct without labels, or if either still reads as an alias/twin
automaticRejects.overlapAndContact: reject any lot/road/neighbor overlap, detached shadow/contact, crop, clipping, or blocked entrance
automaticRejects.fallbackAndFidelity: reject any fallback, missing resource, mirror, rotation, recolor, mixed-fidelity, or material/contact regression
automaticRejects.resourceCeiling: preserve the accepted R4-B resource ceilings; any unexplained increase is a return

comparison.requiredPreservation: R4-B terrain variation, overlap/clipping/fallback/mixed-fidelity/material/contact behavior, pointer placement, keyboard map focus, command-guide Escape, and compact Focus City remain equivalent or better

interactionSanity.pointerPlacement: one visible pointer road placement with action/Undo signal; capture live/interaction/pointer-placement.png
interactionSanity.keyboardMapFocus: Arrow navigation on the focused map with AX-selected target transition; capture live/interaction/keyboard-map-focus.png
interactionSanity.commandGuideEscape: open command guide and press Escape back to map; capture live/interaction/command-guide-escape.png
interactionSanity.compactFocusCity: enter Focus City at exact 900x600, frame Developed City, and verify map/HUD legibility; capture live/interaction/compact-focus-city.png

validation.candidateEvidence: blocked until Integration supplies one exact candidate and exclusive frontier QA lease
validation.fullGateOwner: Integration exact R4-E candidate binding/build; independent FRONTIER_AUTHORITY owns later final QA

stopConditions: identity, authority, claim, or prior-baseline mismatch
missing authority bytes or any path outside the one allowed evidence root
need to inspect renderer implementation or alter product/source/fixture/harness/shared authority
candidate-specific coaching, build, staging, launch, scoring, or acceptance
failure outside focused preregistration scope, subjective judgment, or contract decision
